Tests architecting a compliant, low-latency asset portal across regions with identity, security, and cost governance.

- GitHub Actions multi-stage deployment
- Cross-region DR and governance

# Terraform skeleton illustrating RA-GRS and a basic immutability setup (illustrative)
provider "azurerm" { features {} }

resource "azurerm_resource_group" "rg" {
  name     = "rg-prod"
  location = "eastus"
}

resource "azurerm_storage_account" "storage" {
  name                     = "assetstorageprod"
  resource_group_name      = azurerm_resource_group.rg.name

## Why This Is Asked
This question tests ability to design a resilient Azure-based backend for a global audience with fault isolation and cost discipline. It also checks familiarity with IaC pipelines, auth integration, and cross-region considerations.

## Key Concepts
- Global routing with Front Door and TLS termination
- Cosmos DB multi-region with controlled failover

- Caching/session state strategy
- Entra ID integration for auth
- IaC-driven CI/CD (Terraform/Bicep)
- Lightweight DR testing and monitoring

## Code Example
```terraform
resource "azurerm_cosmosdb_account" "news" {
  name                      = "newsdb"
  location                  = "West Europe"
  offer_type                = "Standard"
  kind                      = "GlobalDocumentDB"
  enable_automatic_failover = true
  locations {
    location_name     = "West Europe"
    failover_priority = 0
  }
  locations {
    location_name     = "East US"
    failover_priority = 1
  }
}
```

- What are the trade-offs of multi-region writes vs single-region writes with cross-region replication?
